$ grep -n '' reports/V9-S6-DESIGN/tier1-explore/explore_s6a.py | sed -n '53,66p'
53:def score_pool(pool, nets):
54:    """Per sample: (disagreement, true error of the ensemble mean), each the max over disks."""
55:    dis, err = {}, {}
56:    for n, e in pool.by_n.items():
57:        p, v, pil = mx.array(e["p"]), mx.array(e["v"]), mx.array(e["pil"])
58:        preds = []
59:        for net in nets:
60:            _, vv, _, _ = net(p, v, pil)
61:            preds.append(np.array(vv, dtype=np.float64))
62:        st = np.stack(preds)
63:        mean = st.mean(0)
64:        dis[n] = np.linalg.norm(st - mean[None], axis=-1).mean(0).max(-1)
65:        err[n] = np.linalg.norm(mean - e["v1"], axis=-1).max(-1)
66:    return dis, err
